AntiquityFive civilisations
Fifty lectures on the ancient world

The world before ours

Five civilisations that made the Mediterranean and the Near East, told as long-form narrative history: Egypt and its three thousand years, the Persian empire that dwarfed them all, the quarrelsome Greek cities, the sea-lords of Carthage, and the republic that swallowed everything. Each with its own map, drawn to real coordinates.

Set in PT Serif and Outfit · coastlines from Natural Earth, projected to real coordinates.
